executive_summary: Net profit was INR 195,000.00 below budget, driven by unfavorable variances in India and Australia, partially offset by favorable variances in Singapore and Australia.
The largest explained drivers include India's Distribution costs (INR 240,000.00 unfavorable) and Australia's Employee costs (INR 150,000.00 favorable).
Unexplained variances total INR 515,000.00, with India's Distribution and Australia's Distribution being key areas requiring further review.

lines.commentary: India Operations Distribution was INR 240,000.00 above budget, with INR 180,000.00 explained due to urgent air freight for festive-season stock after a supplier delay.
Australia Sales Employee costs were INR 150,000.00 below budget, fully explained by two vacant roles in the Sydney sales team.
Singapore Operations Employee costs were INR 90,000.00 below budget, fully explained by two warehouse supervisors moving to the Singapore Sales cost centre.
India Corporate Consulting was INR 75,000.00 above budget, fully explained by unbudgeted tax advisory support for the GST audit.
Australia Operations Distribution was INR 70,000.00 above budget, with no confirmed explanation.
India Sales Employee costs were INR 60,000.00 above budget, with no confirmed explanation.
India Corporate Recruitment was INR 15,000.00 below budget, fully explained by a refund of the July placement fee after a candidate withdrew.
